hed: Unveiling MCG 12-17-9: A Distant Galaxy in Draco

body:

Its position at approximately 17.824 hours in right ascension and 70.14 degrees in declination places it well within the bounds of this northern constellation, making it an accessible target for dedicated amateur astronomers equipped with suitable instrumentation.
